scientific_significance.description: Affected fields and their concrete impact. high means a direct change to core understanding, methods, or capability; medium means clear progress or material downstream impact; low means a local, indirect, or incremental effect.

solution_difficulty.description: Possible obstacles to solving the problem, without a numeric score.

verification_contract.description: Acceptance contracts keyed by answer type. It may be null only when a parent delegates verification to listed subproblems.

ci_contract.description: The mechanically executable part: what result is consumed, what is checked, and what makes it pass or fail. Null means no reasonable mechanical check.

verification_difficulty.description: One overall residual review-difficulty score after mechanically checkable parts of every verification contract have been removed. 0: no residual judgment; 1-3: a few local standard checks; 4-6: connected derivations or substantial problem-answer correspondence work; 7-9: long, fragile, or novel reasoning or substantial code review; 10: holistic expert judgment. This is not solution difficulty and not a gate.
